description:
Title: Software .Net Developer 
 Location: Little Rock, AR. 
 Duration: 12 Months 

 Basic Qualifications:  
 To be considered for this position, you must minimally meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computers, Math, or equivalent 

 3 year's plus experience working hands-on with Microsoft.Net and C# or VB.Net (C# preferable) 
 Hands-on experience working with SQL 
 4 year’s experience will be accepted in lieu of a Bachelor's degree Preferred 
 

 Qualifications:  
 Candidates with these desired skills will be given preferential consideration:  
 Bachelor's degree in Computers, Math, or equivalent 
 Experience working hands-on with C# and/or VB.Net 
 Experience with SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services)
 Experience with SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
 
 Roles and Responsibilities:  
 Microsoft ASP.Net, MVC and Windows Store application development and support
 SQL Server 2008 and 2012 development 
 SQL Server Integration Services development  
 SQL Server Reporting Services development 
 Client coordination and definition of requirements
